findings.issue: Wrong description of 術's structure: the 行 ("ir/caminho") radical wraps the character (彳 left, 亍 right); what sits in the middle is 朮, not the 行 radical. Every other kanji note in the lesson gives the position correctly, so this one misleads.
findings.current: 術 ("arte, técnica"): no meio o radical de "ir/caminho"; a técnica como um caminho dominado.
findings.suggested: 術 ("arte, técnica"): ao redor, o radical 行 ("ir/caminho"), com 朮 no meio; a técnica como um caminho dominado.

findings.issue: Spelling: the pt-BR adverb is "embaixo" (one word); "em baixo" is the pt-PT/incorrect form. The sibling lesson uses "embaixo" correctly in the same kanji-note pattern.
findings.current: 育 ("criar, educar, crescer"): em baixo o radical de "carne/corpo"
findings.suggested: 育 ("criar, educar, crescer"): embaixo o radical de "carne/corpo"

findings.issue: Kanji decomposition is inverted: in 術 the 行 radical ("ir/caminho") wraps the character (彳 left + 亍 right); what sits in the middle is 术, not the radical.
findings.current: 術 ("arte, técnica"): no meio o radical de "ir/caminho"
findings.suggested: 術 ("arte, técnica"): ao redor, o radical de "ir/caminho" (行), com 术 no meio

findings.issue: The rule lists the forms that precede ように as exhaustive and omits the very common negative ない form (忘れないように, 風邪をひかないように), which the next lesson itself uses (しないように).
findings.current: Antes de ように usa-se a forma de dicionário ou o potencial, nunca a volitiva.
findings.suggested: Antes de ように usa-se a forma de dicionário, o potencial ou a negativa ない (忘れないように), nunca a volitiva.

findings.issue: pt-BR spelling: the adverb is written as one word, 'embaixo' (as used elsewhere in the same list for 労 and in lesson 03 for 警), not 'em baixo'.
findings.current: 育 ("criar, educar, crescer"): em baixo o radical de "carne/corpo"
findings.suggested: 育 ("criar, educar, crescer"): embaixo o radical de "carne/corpo"
